Dear Jimi,

Thank you so much for your kind words and for taking the time to share your experience. We are truly glad that Dr. Batric Vukčević and our entire team were able to make such a difficult situation a little easier and provide your mother with the care and reassurance she needed.

We will gladly share your appreciation with our doctors and nurses. We wish your mother a speedy and full recovery, and we are grateful for your trust. It was our pleasure to care for her.

Kind regards,
Konzilijum Team

Dear Joan,

We are very sorry to hear that you had this impression during your visit to our clinic. We understand that arriving in an emergency situation can be stressful, and we regret that your experience at our reception left you feeling that your concerns were not taken seriously.

Please be assured that our reception staff would never intentionally laugh at or make light of a patient’s situation. We believe in treating every patient with respect, understanding, and professionalism. If their reaction was perceived differently, we sincerely apologize for the misunderstanding and, most importantly, for any discomfort or upset it may have caused you.

We truly appreciate you sharing your experience, as feedback such as this helps us reflect on how we communicate with and support our patients. We are sorry that your experience did not meet the standard of care and courtesy we strive to provide.

Kind regards,
Konzilijum Team

Poštovana Slađana,

Žao nam je što čujemo da ste imali ovakvo iskustvo. Ono svakako nije svojstveno načinu na koji poslujemo i odnosu koji nastojimo da pružimo svakom našem pacijentu.

Međutim, na osnovu informacija iz Vašeg komentara, nismo uspjeli da identifikujemo ovaj konkretan slučaj. Bili bismo Vam zahvalni ukoliko biste nas kontaktirali putem e-maila info@konzilijum.me ili broja telefona 067 650 670 kako bismo mogli da stupimo u kontakt sa Vama, detaljnije sagledamo okolnosti i utvrdimo šta se dogodilo.

Vaše mišljenje nam je izuzetno važno, jer nam pomaže da unaprijedimo kvalitet naših usluga. Unaprijed zahvaljujemo na javljanju i nadamo se prilici da razjasnimo ovu situaciju.

Srdačan pozdrav,
Konzilijum Poliklinika i bolnica
